set.body: Replace the ad hoc AR(1) GLS branch with a plan-based whitening interpreter. Scope: OLS residuals -> AR whitening plan -> whitened design/response -> OLS on whitened data -> AR diagnostics and standard errors. Acceptance: existing AR(1) GLS behavior remains green; AR(2) fixed-plan GLS is supported; censor gaps are honored; unsupported ARMA/parcel modes fail explicitly until implemented.
set.title: Slice 15: plan-based AR/GLS fit integration
